title: Meta's AG settlement says its age verification framework will use "reliable age signals" shared with it by "OS and app stores operated by Apple and Google" (Lauren Feiner/The Verge)
summary: Lauren Feiner / The Verge: Meta's AG settlement says its age verification framework will use “reliable age signals” shared with it by “OS and app stores operated by Apple and Google” — Under its splashy agreement with state AGs, Meta gets to flaunt the high road, while dragging its competitors.
contentText:
Lauren Feiner / The Verge :

Meta's AG settlement says its age verification framework will use “reliable age signals” shared with it by “OS and app stores operated by Apple and Google”   —  ﻿Under its splashy agreement with state AGs, Meta gets to flaunt the high road, while dragging its competitors.
